name: paradise
description: The Paradise setup door for Claude Code and Codex: install the plugins you pick, apply a portable settings and guidance baseline that backs up first and never touches your own text outside its markers, and set up Codex features and hook trust.

interface.shortDescription: Set up Claude Code and Codex in the terminal with a portable baseline.
interface.longDescription: The setup door for the Paradise marketplace. setup asks one batch of questions, installs the chosen plugins, and runs the focused skills: claude-code-setup merges a few universal settings keys, installs a context-meter statusline, and writes a marker-bounded guidance block into the global CLAUDE.md (and the same block into Codex's AGENTS.md), backing up each file first; codex-setup enables plugin hooks, leaves the built-in memories choice to the user, and walks through one-time hook trust.
